news.summary: 輝達（NVIDIA）宣布攜手全球供應鏈擴大AI製造產能，在公布的供應鏈背板中，除了包含台達電（2308）、技嘉（2376）、緯創（3231）、和碩（4938）、鴻海（2317）旗下鴻佰科技及廣達（2382）旗下雲達科技等6家台灣廠商外，台廠京元電（2449）、欣興（3037）及矽品均入列。其中，輝達將向京元電提供11億美元產能預約預付款，支援在美國建置測試廠房及設備，目標2027年4月進入大量生產；另透過欣興擴充台灣載板產能，並與矽品合作大幅增加共同封裝光學（CPO）所需的光引擎產能。 《詳全文...》
news.title_en: Not just 6 old AI stocks! NVIDIA's Jensen Huang calls 'capacity bottleneck' and endorses 3 Taiwanese factories to expand production.
news.summary_en: NVIDIA announces collaboration with global supply chain to expand AI manufacturing capacity. In the disclosed supply chain backplane, besides including Delta Electronics （2308）, Gigabyte （2376）, Wistron （3231）, Pegatron （4938）, Foxconn （2317） subsidiary Foxconn Interconnect Technology and Quanta （2382） subsidiary CloudTech, totaling 6 Taiwanese manufacturers, Taiwanese companies Chin Yuan Electric （2449）, Unimicron （3037） and Siliconware are also listed. Among them, NVIDIA will provide USD 1100000000 capacity reservation prepayment to Chin Yuan Electric, supporting the construction of test factories and equipment in the US, targeting 2027 year 4 month to enter mass production; also through Unimicron expanding Taiwan substrate capacity, and cooperating with Siliconware to significantly increase optical engine capacity required for co-packaged optics (CPO). 《Read full article...》

news.title_en: Not just 6 old AI stocks! NVIDIA's Jensen Huang calls 'capacity bottleneck' and endorses 3 Taiwanese factories to expand production.
news.summary_en: NVIDIA announces collaboration with global supply chain to expand AI manufacturing capacity. In the disclosed supply chain backplane, besides including Delta Electronics （2308）, Gigabyte （2376）, Wistron （3231）, Pegatron （4938）, Foxconn （2317） subsidiary Foxconn Interconnect Technology and Quanta （2382） subsidiary CloudTech, totaling 6 Taiwanese manufacturers, Taiwanese companies Chin Yuan Electric （2449）, Unimicron （3037） and Siliconware are also listed. Among them, NVIDIA will provide USD 1100000000 capacity reservation prepayment to Chin Yuan Electric, supporting the construction of test factories and equipment in the US, targeting 2027 year 4 month to enter mass production; also through Unimicron expanding Taiwan substrate capacity, and cooperating with Siliconware to significantly increase optical engine capacity required for co-packaged optics (CPO). 《Read full article...》

In addition, NVIDIA's high-speed transmission key partner Credo launched a micro-emission architecture new product to assist, revealing that AUO and FocalTech（3714）, Dynapack（2426） and other AUO group members are not only still in the game attacking CPO with Micro LED, but have also launched a full-scale mobilization.

items.title: 大立光、友達掀單模多模之爭！彭双浪：法說就法說，什麼叫開法會？
items.summary: 大立光（3008）董事長林恩平日前於法說會中指Micro LED在矽光子領域的「不太可能」，此番言論遭外界戲稱「幫友達開法會」，對此友達（2409）董事長彭双浪表示不滿，他表示，或許一開始這樣說是好玩，但此舉對公司、股東跟市場的傷害都很大，其實沒有必要。

items.title: Credo新品助陣＋彭双浪駁林恩平觀點 友達靠 Micro LED 衝 CPO 還有戲
items.summary: 大立光（3008）董事長林恩平日前一席Micro LED切入CPO「不可行」的談話，引發市場議論。友達（2409）董事長彭双浪出面高喊「應該是誤解」，強調技術各有優劣，加上輝達高速傳輸關鍵夥伴Credo端出微發光架構新品助陣，透露友達與富采（3714）、鼎元（2426）等泛友達集團成員以Micro LED攻CPO不僅還有戲，更已展開總動員出擊。

news.title: 因應歐盟 CRA 新規 研華攜手 DEKRA 德凱簽署 MOU
news.summary: 隨著歐盟《網路韌性法案》（Cyber Resilience Act, CRA）逐步進入實施階段，資安合規正成為工業設備與邊緣 AI 產品進入全球市場的重要門檻。研華（2395）宣布攜手全球領先的檢驗、檢測與驗證機構DEKRA德凱，結合雙方在工業運算、資安測試與全球認證的專業，協助終端應用客戶與系統整合商從產品設計階段即導入資安要求，加速因應歐盟CRA法規要求與IEC 62443標準等規範，降低合規風險並縮短產品進入全球市場的時程。
news.title_en: In response to EU CRA new regulations, Advantech partners with DEKRA to sign MOU
news.summary_en: As the EU's Cyber Resilience Act (CRA) gradually enters implementation phase, cybersecurity compliance is becoming a critical threshold for industrial equipment and edge AI products entering global markets. Advantech （2395） announced partnership with global leading testing, inspection and certification body DEKRA, combining both parties' expertise in industrial computing, security testing and global certification, to help end-application customers and system integrators introduce security requirements from product design stage, accelerate compliance with EU CRA regulations and IEC 62443 standards, reducing compliance risks and shortening time-to-market for products globally.

news.title_en: Not just 6 old AI stocks! NVIDIA's Jensen Huang calls 'capacity bottleneck' and endorses 3 Taiwanese factories to expand production.
news.summary_en: NVIDIA announces collaboration with global supply chain to expand AI manufacturing capacity. In the disclosed supply chain backplane, besides including Delta Electronics （2308）, Gigabyte （2376）, Wistron （3231）, Pegatron （4938）, Foxconn （2317） subsidiary Foxconn Interconnect Technology and Quanta （2382） subsidiary CloudTech, totaling 6 Taiwanese manufacturers, Taiwanese companies Chin Yuan Electric （2449）, Unimicron （3037） and Siliconware are also listed. Among them, NVIDIA will provide USD 1100000000 capacity reservation prepayment to Chin Yuan Electric, supporting the construction of test factories and equipment in the US, targeting 2027 year 4 month to enter mass production; also through Unimicron expanding Taiwan substrate capacity, and cooperating with Siliconware to significantly increase optical engine capacity required for co-packaged optics (CPO). 《Read full article...》

news.title: Meta 營收創新高 上調資本支出下限 台廠 AI 供應鏈有望受惠
news.summary: 美國CSP巨頭Meta公布第3季營收創歷史新高紀錄，第4季指引也超出市場預期，顯示算力需求仍持續成長。Meta同時調高2026年資本支出下限，並宣布將發行無投票權新類別股票，支撐AI軍備競賽資金需求。法人看好，CSP廠持續增加資本支出，鴻海（2317）、廣達（2382）、緯創（3231）、緯穎（6669）等重要ODM供應鏈都將持續受惠。
news.title_en: Meta revenue hits new high; raises capital expenditure floor; Taiwan AI supply chain poised to benefit
news.summary_en: US CSP giant Meta announces Q3 revenue hits record high, Q4 guidance also exceeds market expectations, showing compute demand continues to grow. Meta simultaneously raises 2026 year capital expenditure floor, and announces issuance of new class of non-voting shares to support AI arms race funding needs. Institutions optimistic; CSP vendors continue to increase capex; Hon Hai （2317）, Quanta （2382）, Wistron （3231）, Wiwynn （6669） and other key ODM supply chains will continue to benefit.

news.title: Meta 營收創新高 上調資本支出下限 台廠 AI 供應鏈有望受惠
news.summary: 美國CSP巨頭Meta公布第3季營收創歷史新高紀錄，第4季指引也超出市場預期，顯示算力需求仍持續成長。Meta同時調高2026年資本支出下限，並宣布將發行無投票權新類別股票，支撐AI軍備競賽資金需求。法人看好，CSP廠持續增加資本支出，鴻海（2317）、廣達（2382）、緯創（3231）、緯穎（6669）等重要ODM供應鏈都將持續受惠。
news.title_en: Meta revenue hits new high; raises capital expenditure floor; Taiwan AI supply chain poised to benefit
news.summary_en: US CSP giant Meta announces Q3 revenue hits record high, Q4 guidance also exceeds market expectations, showing compute demand continues to grow. Meta simultaneously raises 2026 year capital expenditure floor, and announces issuance of new class of non-voting shares to support AI arms race funding needs. Institutions optimistic; CSP vendors continue to increase capex; Hon Hai （2317）, Quanta （2382）, Wistron （3231）, Wiwynn （6669） and other key ODM supply chains will continue to benefit.

news.title: 遠傳5G 救援再升級「5G 緊急救護一站通」上路
news.summary: 遠傳（4904）電信近年將5G技術投入智慧醫療及緊急救護，遠傳表示，為緊急傷病患爭取黃金救援時間，遠傳「5G緊急救護一站通」22日起正式上路，新增「即時影像、即時資訊、即時協作」三大應用功能，讓緊急救護技術員（Emergency Medical Technician; EMT）在前線執勤時，可在救護車內將患者生理樣態、即時影像、處置作為等資訊透過5G行動網路傳輸，與急救責任醫院急診室共享資訊，讓醫療團隊可透過遠距視訊協作與指導，一同為患者爭取更多黃金救治時間，提升到院前緊急救護品質。

news.summary: 輝達（NVIDIA）執行長黃仁勳21日表示，全球正迎來人類史上最大規模的基礎建設浪潮，「AI需求異常強勁，產能才是瓶頸（Demand is extraordinary. Capacity is the constraint）。」為加速AI基礎建設，輝達宣布攜手全球六大供應鏈夥伴擴充產能，涵蓋載板、先進封裝、半導體測試及共同封裝光學（CPO），台廠包括日月光投控（3711）旗下矽品、京元電子（2449）及欣興（3037）均入列。

news.title: 不止6檔老AI股！ 輝達黃仁勳喊「產能瓶頸」欽點3台廠擴產
news.summary: 輝達（NVIDIA）宣布攜手全球供應鏈擴大AI製造產能，在公布的供應鏈背板中，除了包含台達電（2308）、技嘉（2376）、緯創（3231）、和碩（4938）、鴻海（2317）旗下鴻佰科技及廣達（2382）旗下雲達科技等6家台灣廠商外，台廠京元電（2449）、欣興（3037）及矽品均入列。其中，輝達將向京元電提供11億美元產能預約預付款，支援在美國建置測試廠房及設備，目標2027年4月進入大量生產；另透過欣興擴充台灣載板產能，並與矽品合作大幅增加共同封裝光學（CPO）所需的光引擎產能。 《詳全文...》
news.title_en: Not just 6 old AI stocks! NVIDIA's Jensen Huang calls 'capacity bottleneck' and endorses 3 Taiwanese factories to expand production.
news.summary_en: NVIDIA announces collaboration with global supply chain to expand AI manufacturing capacity. In the disclosed supply chain backplane, besides including Delta Electronics （2308）, Gigabyte （2376）, Wistron （3231）, Pegatron （4938）, Foxconn （2317） subsidiary Foxconn Interconnect Technology and Quanta （2382） subsidiary CloudTech, totaling 6 Taiwanese manufacturers, Taiwanese companies Chin Yuan Electric （2449）, Unimicron （3037） and Siliconware are also listed. Among them, NVIDIA will provide USD 1100000000 capacity reservation prepayment to Chin Yuan Electric, supporting the construction of test factories and equipment in the US, targeting 2027 year 4 month to enter mass production; also through Unimicron expanding Taiwan substrate capacity, and cooperating with Siliconware to significantly increase optical engine capacity required for co-packaged optics (CPO). 《Read full article...》

news.title_en: Not just 6 old AI stocks! NVIDIA's Jensen Huang calls 'capacity bottleneck' and endorses 3 Taiwanese factories to expand production.
news.summary_en: NVIDIA announces collaboration with global supply chain to expand AI manufacturing capacity. In the disclosed supply chain backplane, besides including Delta Electronics （2308）, Gigabyte （2376）, Wistron （3231）, Pegatron （4938）, Foxconn （2317） subsidiary Foxconn Interconnect Technology and Quanta （2382） subsidiary CloudTech, totaling 6 Taiwanese manufacturers, Taiwanese companies Chin Yuan Electric （2449）, Unimicron （3037） and Siliconware are also listed.
